biography: Walter Guanabara, a son of Rio de Janeiro, didn't grow up with the silver spoon of motorsport. His father, a mechanic at a local garage, instilled in him a love for engines and the scent of burning rubber. Instead of karting, Walter honed his skills navigating the chaotic streets in his father's old Passat, learning car control the hard way. His break came when a local vintage racing team, Passat Classic B, noticed his raw talent during an impromptu street race. His debut race at Interlagos, driving a meticulously restored Passat, was a revelation. Despite a mechanical failure that relegated him to the back of the pack, his aggressive overtaking maneuvers and sheer determination caught the eye of seasoned veterans. Now, at 23, Walter is considered a rising star in the Brazilian classic racing scene, a testament to his natural talent and relentless pursuit of speed.
drivingStyle: Walter's driving style is a blend of controlled aggression and calculated risk. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and uncanny ability to find grip where others can't. He possesses exceptional car control, a skill honed from years of improvisational driving. While he can be fiercely competitive, he also displays a remarkable ability to manage his tires and maintain a consistent pace throughout a race. He thrives under pressure, often pulling off stunning overtakes in the closing laps.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from a controversial collision during the 2022 Interlagos Classic race, where Almeida accused Walter of reckless driving.

quirks: Always wears a faded Ayrton Senna t-shirt under his racing suit.
Listens to samba music to calm his nerves before a race.
Polishes his helmet visor meticulously, claiming it improves his visibility.
famousQuote: "Speed isn't about taking risks; it's about knowing exactly how far you can push before you do."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2023 Ribeirão Preto Classic Race after starting from the back of the grid due to a qualifying engine issue. He showcased masterful overtaking skills to claim victory in the final lap.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at the 2022 São Paulo Classic, costing him valuable championship points and damaging his confidence for several races afterward.
